faq.q: Is Downtown Vice City confirmed by Rockstar?
faq.a: Not directly. It has appeared in Trailer 2 footage and press describes it as the financial core of the city, but Rockstar has not named or described the district in any official material.

faq.q: What is Downtown Vice City based on in real life?
faq.a: Press outlets say it is modeled on Miami's Brickell financial district, with an ultramodern glass tower skyline recreated from trailer footage compared against real Miami photography.

faq.q: Are Ten Museum Park and the Grayson Hotel in GTA 6?
faq.a: Press reports point to buildings resembling Ten Museum Park and the Grayson Hotel, cited as real Miami structures closely recreated based on frame comparisons of trailer footage.

faq.q: What are the exact boundaries of Downtown Vice City?
faq.a: Not known. Rockstar has not named or mapped the district, so its exact boundaries, buildings and in-game name have not been confirmed.
